Gate author writes tests but NEVER runs them. L1 alone runs verification after integration. No credential/auth files or ~/.omp/agent/agent.db*. No separate omp CLI. Do not message Main or agent://all; message TsukuroiR16 only.
Tooling authorization: you may install or upgrade tools that help the task — read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first (official channels, update-safety gate, record tool/version/channel/reason). All pacman transactions PAUSED host-wide: use uv tool/npx/official binary in ~/.local/bin or file an L0 recommendation to L1. Never pacman -Sy/-Syu/-U/-R, downgrade, restart services, or change packages. No installs needed for these static tasks.
Baseline db68e62065885b3f7463eb0a436c41f0dc3bcde5. Correction contract: JSON corpus/knowledge/section-citation-errata-r16.json has schema tsukuroi-section-citation-errata-v1; corrections array two records id R16-BOARD-SECTION/R16-RANK-SECTION, source_id S050, path, old_locator, heading (exact Markdown heading), row_key, quote (exact stable row substring), notice_heading (exact heading appended to target). Board heading '## 0. Verdict board', row_key '| 5 | update-safety |'; rank heading '## 5. Risk-ordered operations table (recommendation only — nothing here was run)', row_key '| 1 | Do nothing now |'. New notices explicitly supersede citation only, preserve R15 current-use supersession and no-package/service authorization. Entry MD opens source:/verified-at:/recheck:.
Gate tools/check-section-citations.py uses git show immutable --revision, not live host. Resolve heading then unique matching row within that heading; quote must match. Require two exact corrections, notices, record/source linkage. Detect actual old wrong section locators at baseline and recognize them as preserved history only when valid new notice resolves. 0 clean,1 failed,2 could-not-evaluate; --selftest isolated fixtures with fixed expected exit and finding ids. Parent records red baseline+green commit+restored defects. Report concerns before deliverable if implementation not yet exists; never claim unseen output passed.
